mapper.select: SELECT T.memberid, T.method, DATE_FORMAT(T.regdate, '%H:%i') regdate FROM ( SELECT memberid, max(attendanceid) as attendanceid FROM ttokssaemdb.attendance WHERE branchid = 'BR00000001' AND regdate > STR_TO_DATE('20230115060000', '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') GROUP BY memberid ) A, ttokssaemdb.attendance T, ttokssaemdb.member M WHERE A.attendanceid = T.attendanceid AND T.memberid = M.memberid AND M.classyn = 'Y'

SELECT memberid, method, hour, minute, status FROM ttokssaemdb.runtimeplan WHERE branchid = #{branchid} AND dayofweek = ${dayofweek} AND memberid = #{memberid} AND status <> 3 ORDER BY sortorder LIMIT 2

SELECT 'Attendance' as tt, '입실' as title, DATE_FORMAT(min(regdate), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as start, 'false' as allDay FROM ttokssaemdb.attendance WHERE memberid = #{memberid} AND method = 0 AND regdate BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY date_format(regdate, '%Y%m%d' ) UNION SELECT 'Attendance' as tt, '퇴실' as title, DATE_FORMAT(max(regdate), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as start, 'false' as allDay FROM ttokssaemdb.attendance WHERE memberid = #{memberid} AND method = 1 AND regdate BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY date_format(regdate, '%Y%m%d' )

SELECT 'Attendance' as tt, CONCAT('입실 ', DATE_FORMAT(regdate, '%H:%i')) as title, DATE_FORMAT(min(regdate), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as start, 'false' as allDay FROM ttokssaemdb.attendance WHERE memberid = #{memberid} AND method = 0 AND regdate BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY date_format(regdate, '%Y%m%d' ) UNION SELECT 'Attendance' as tt, CONCAT('퇴실 ', DATE_FORMAT(regdate, '%H:%i')) as title, DATE_FORMAT(max(regdate), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as start, 'false' as allDay FROM ttokssaemdb.attendance WHERE memberid = #{memberid} AND method = 1 AND regdate BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY date_format(regdate, '%Y%m%d' )
